29.en: "How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,

29.zh: 那时他的灯照在我头上；我藉他的光行过黑暗。
29.en: when his lamp shone upon my head and by his light I walked through darkness!

29.zh: 我愿如壮年的时候：那时我在帐棚中，神待我有密友之情；
29.en: Oh, for the days when I was in my prime, when God's intimate friendship blessed my house,

29.zh: 全能者仍与我同在；我的儿女都环绕我。
29.en: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me,

29.zh: 奶多可洗我的脚；磐石为我出油成河。
29.en: when my path was drenched with cream and the rock poured out for me streams of olive oil.

29.zh: 我出到城门，在街上设立座位；
29.en: "When I went to the gate of the city and took my seat in the public square,

29.zh: 少年人见我而回避，老年人也起身站立；
29.en: the young men saw me and stepped aside and the old men rose to their feet;

29.zh: 王子都停止说话，用手摀口；
29.en: the chief men refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands;

29.zh: 首领静默无声，舌头贴住上膛。
29.en: the voices of the nobles were hushed, and their tongues stuck to the roof of their mouths.

29.zh: 耳朵听我的，就称我有福；眼睛看我的，便称赞我；
29.en: Whoever heard me spoke well of me, and those who saw me commended me,

29.zh: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人和无人帮助的孤儿。
29.en: because I rescued the poor who cried for help, and the fatherless who had none to assist him.

29.zh: 将要灭亡的为我祝福；我也使寡妇心中欢乐。
29.en: The man who was dying blessed me; I made the widow's heart sing.

29.zh: 我以公义为衣服，以公平为外袍和冠冕。
29.en: I put on righteousness as my clothing; justice was my robe and my turban.

29.zh: 我为瞎子的眼，瘸子的脚。
29.en: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame.

29.zh: 我为穷乏人的父；素不认识的人，我查明他的案件。
29.en: I was a father to the needy; I took up the case of the stranger.

29.zh: 我打破不义之人的牙床，从他牙齿中夺了所抢的。
29.en: I broke the fangs of the wicked and snatched the victims from their teeth.

29.zh: 我便说：我必死在家中（原文是窝中），必增添我的日子，多如尘沙。
29.en: "I thought, 'I will die in my own house, my days as numerous as the grains of sand.

29.zh: 我的根长到水边；露水终夜沾在我的枝上。
29.en: My roots will reach to the water, and the dew will lie all night on my branches.

29.zh: 我的荣耀在身上增新；我的弓在手中日强。
29.en: My glory will remain fresh in me, the bow ever new in my hand.'

29.zh: 人听见我而仰望，静默等候我的指教。
29.en: "Men listened to me expectantly, waiting in silence for my counsel.

29.zh: 我说话之后，他们就不再说；我的言语像雨露滴在他们身上。
29.en: After I had spoken, they spoke no more; my words fell gently on their ears.

29.zh: 他们仰望我如仰望雨，又张开口如切慕春雨。
29.en: They waited for me as for showers and drank in my words as the spring rain.

29.zh: 他们不敢自信，我就向他们含笑；他们不使我脸上的光改变。
29.en: When I smiled at them, they scarcely believed it; the light of my face was precious to them.

29.zh: 我为他们选择道路，又坐首位；我如君王在军队中居住，又如吊丧的安慰伤心的人。
29.en: I chose the way for them and sat as their chief; I dwelt as a king among his troops; I was like one who comforts mourners.

30.zh: 但如今，比我年少的人戏笑我；其人之父我曾藐视，不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。
30.en: "But now they mock me, men younger than I, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.

30.zh: 他们壮年的气力既已衰败，其手之力与我何益呢？
30.en: Of what use was the strength of their hands to me, since their vigor had gone from them?

30.zh: 他们因穷乏饥饿，身体枯瘦，在荒废凄凉的幽暗中，龈干燥之地，
30.en: Haggard from want and hunger, they roamed the parched land in desolate wastelands at night.

30.zh: 在草丛之中采咸草，罗腾（小树名，松类）的根为他们的食物。
30.en: In the brush they gathered salt herbs, and their food was the root of the broom tree.

30.zh: 他们从人中被赶出；人追喊他们如贼一般，
30.en: They were banished from their fellow men, shouted at as if they were thieves.

30.zh: 以致他们住在荒谷之间，在地洞和岩穴中；
30.en: They were forced to live in the dry stream beds, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.

30.zh: 在草丛中叫唤，在荆棘下聚集。
30.en: They brayed among the bushes and huddled in the undergrowth.

30.zh: 这都是愚顽下贱人的儿女；他们被鞭打，赶出境外。
30.en: A base and nameless brood, they were driven out of the land.

30.zh: 现在这些人以我为歌曲，以我为笑谈。
30.en: "And now their sons mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.

30.zh: 他们厌恶我，躲在旁边站著，不住地吐唾沫在我脸上。
30.en: They detest me and keep their distance; they do not hesitate to spit in my face.

30.zh: 松开他们的绳索苦待我，在我面前脱去辔头。
30.en: Now that God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they throw off restraint in my presence.

30.zh: 这等下流人在我右边起来，推开我的脚，筑成战路来攻击我。
30.en: On my right the tribe attacks; they lay snares for my feet, they build their siege ramps against me.

30.zh: 这些无人帮助的，毁坏我的道，加增我的灾。
30.en: They break up my road; they succeed in destroying me- without anyone's helping them.

30.zh: 他们来如同闯进大破口，在毁坏之间滚在我身上。
30.en: They advance as through a gaping breach; amid the ruins they come rolling in.

30.zh: 惊恐临到我，驱逐我的尊荣如风；我的福禄如云过去。
30.en: Terrors overwhelm me; my dignity is driven away as by the wind, my safety vanishes like a cloud.

30.zh: 现在我心极其悲伤；困苦的日子将我抓住。
30.en: "And now my life ebbs away; days of suffering grip me.

30.zh: 夜间，我里面的骨头刺我，疼痛不止，好像龈我。
30.en: Night pierces my bones; my gnawing pains never rest.

30.zh: 因神的大力，我的外衣污秽不堪，又如里衣的领子将我缠住。
30.en: In his great power God becomes like clothing to me ; he binds me like the neck of my garment.

30.zh: 神把我扔在淤泥中，我就像尘土和炉灰一般。
30.en: He throws me into the mud, and I am reduced to dust and ashes.

30.zh: 主啊，我呼求你，你不应允我；我站起来，你就定睛看我。
30.en: "I cry out to you, O God, but you do not answer; I stand up, but you merely look at me.

30.zh: 你向我变心，待我残忍，又用大能追逼我，
30.en: You turn on me ruthlessly; with the might of your hand you attack me.

30.zh: 把我提在风中，使我驾风而行，又使我消灭在烈风中。
30.en: You snatch me up and drive me before the wind; you toss me about in the storm.

30.zh: 我知道要使我临到死地，到那为众生所定的阴宅。
30.en: I know you will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.

30.zh: 然而，人仆倒岂不伸手？遇灾难岂不求救呢？
30.en: "Surely no one lays a hand on a broken man when he cries for help in his distress.

30.zh: 人遭难，我岂不为他哭泣呢？人穷乏，我岂不为他忧愁呢？
30.en: Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has not my soul grieved for the poor?

30.zh: 我仰望得好处，灾祸就到了；我等待光明，黑暗便来了。
30.en: Yet when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, then came darkness.

30.zh: 我心里烦扰不安，困苦的日子临到我身。
30.en: The churning inside me never stops; days of suffering confront me.

30.zh: 我没有日光就哀哭行去（或译：我面发黑并非因日晒）；我在会中站著求救。
30.en: I go about blackened, but not by the sun; I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.

30.zh: 我与野狗为弟兄，与鸵鸟为同伴。
30.en: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of owls.

30.zh: 我的皮肤黑而脱落；我的骨头因热烧焦。
30.en: My skin grows black and peels; my body burns with fever.

30.zh: 所以，我的琴音变为悲音；我的箫声变为哭声。
30.en: My harp is tuned to mourning, and my flute to the sound of wailing.

31.zh: 我与眼睛立约，怎能恋恋瞻望处女呢？
31.en: "I made a covenant with my eyesnot to look lustfully at a girl.

31.zh: 从至上的神所得之分，从至高全能者所得之业是甚么呢？
31.en: For what is man's lot from God above, his heritage from the Almighty on high?

31.zh: 岂不是祸患临到不义的，灾害临到作孽的呢？
31.en: Is it not ruin for the wicked, disaster for those who do wrong?

31.zh: 神岂不是察看我的道路，数点我的脚步呢？
31.en: Does he not see my ways and count my every step?

31.zh: 我若与虚谎同行，脚若追随诡诈；
31.en: "If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has hurried after deceit-

31.zh: （我若被公道的天平称度，使神可以知道我的纯正；）
31.en: let God weigh me in honest scales and he will know that I am blameless-

31.zh: 我的脚步若偏离正路，我的心若随著我的眼目，若有玷污粘在我手上；
31.en: if my steps have turned from the path, if my heart has been led by my eyes, or if my hands have been defiled,

31.zh: 就愿我所种的有别人吃，我田所产的被拔出来。
31.en: then may others eat what I have sown, and may my crops be uprooted.

31.zh: 我若受迷惑，向妇人起淫念，在邻舍的门外蹲伏，
31.en: "If my heart has been enticed by a woman, or if I have lurked at my neighbor's door,

31.zh: 就愿我的妻子给别人推磨，别人也与他同室。
31.en: then may my wife grind another man's grain, and may other men sleep with her.

31.zh: 因为这是大罪，是审判官当罚的罪孽。
31.en: For that would have been shameful, a sin to be judged.

31.zh: 这本是火焚烧，直到毁灭，必拔除我所有的家产。
31.en: It is a fire that burns to Destruction ; it would have uprooted my harvest.

31.zh: 我的仆婢与我争辩的时候，我若藐视不听他们的情节；
31.en: "If I have denied justice to my menservants and maidservants when they had a grievance against me,

31.zh: 神兴起，我怎样行呢？他察问，我怎样回答呢？
31.en: what will I do when God confronts me? What will I answer when called to account?

31.zh: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他么？将他与我抟在腹中的岂不是一位么？
31.en: Did not he who made me in the womb make them? Did not the same one form us both within our mothers?

31.zh: 我若不容贫寒人得其所愿，或叫寡妇眼中失望，
31.en: "If I have denied the desires of the poor or let the eyes of the widow grow weary,

31.zh: 或独自吃我一点食物，孤儿没有与我同吃；
31.en: if I have kept my bread to myself, not sharing it with the fatherless-

31.zh: （从幼年时孤儿与我同长，好像父子一样；我从出母腹就扶助寡妇。）
31.en: but from my youth I reared him as would a father, and from my birth I guided the widow-

31.zh: 我若见人因无衣死亡，或见穷乏人身无遮盖；
31.en: if I have seen anyone perishing for lack of clothing, or a needy man without a garment,

31.zh: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖，为我祝福；
31.en: and his heart did not bless me for warming him with the fleece from my sheep,

31.zh: 我若在城门口见有帮助我的，举手攻击孤儿；
31.en: if I have raised my hand against the fatherless, knowing that I had influence in court,

31.zh: 情愿我的肩头从缺盆骨脱落，我的膀臂从羊矢骨折断。
31.en: then let my arm fall from the shoulder, let it be broken off at the joint.

31.zh: 因神降的灾祸使我恐惧；因他的威严，我不能妄为。
31.en: For I dreaded destruction from God, and for fear of his splendor I could not do such things.

31.zh: 我若以黄金为指望，对精金说：你是我的倚靠；
31.en: "If I have put my trust in gold or said to pure gold, 'You are my security,'

31.zh: 我若因财物丰裕，因我手多得资财而欢喜；
31.en: if I have rejoiced over my great wealth, the fortune my hands had gained,

31.zh: 我若见太阳发光，明月行在空中，
31.en: if I have regarded the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor,

31.zh: 心就暗暗被引诱，口便亲手；
31.en: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand offered them a kiss of homage,

31.zh: 这也是审判官当罚的罪孽，又是我背弃在上的神。
31.en: then these also would be sins to be judged, for I would have been unfaithful to God on high.

31.zh: 我若见恨我的遭报就欢喜，见他遭灾便高兴；
31.en: "If I have rejoiced at my enemy's misfortune or gloated over the trouble that came to him-

31.zh: （我没有容口犯罪，咒诅他的生命；）
31.en: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by invoking a curse against his life-

31.zh: 若我帐棚的人未尝说，谁不以主人的食物吃饱呢？
31.en: if the men of my household have never said, 'Who has not had his fill of Job's meat?'-

31.zh: （从来我没有容客旅在街上住宿，却开门迎接行路的人；）
31.en: but no stranger had to spend the night in the street, for my door was always open to the traveler-

31.zh: 我若像亚当（或译：别人）遮掩我的过犯，将罪孽藏在怀中；
31.en: if I have concealed my sin as men do, by hiding my guilt in my heart

31.zh: 因惧怕大众，又因宗族藐视我使我惊恐，以致闭口无言，杜门不出；
31.en: because I so feared the crowd and so dreaded the contempt of the clans that I kept silent and would not go outside

31.zh: 惟愿有一位肯听我！（看哪，在这里有我所划的押，愿全能者回答我！）
31.en: ("Oh, that I had someone to hear me! I sign now my defense-let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser put his indictment in writing.

31.zh: 愿那敌我者所写的状词在我这里！我必带在肩上，又绑在头上为冠冕。
31.en: Surely I would wear it on my shoulder, I would put it on like a crown.

31.zh: 我必向他述说我脚步的数目，必如君王进到他面前。
31.en: I would give him an account of my every step; like a prince I would approach him.)-

31.zh: 我若夺取田地，这地向我喊冤，犁沟一同哭泣；
31.en: "if my land cries out against me and all its furrows are wet with tears,

31.zh: 我若吃地的出产不给价值，或叫原主丧命；
31.en: if I have devoured its yield without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,

31.zh: 愿这地长蒺藜代替麦子，长恶草代替大麦。约伯的话说完了。
31.en: then let briers come up instead of wheat and weeds instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.

32.zh: 于是这三个人，因约伯自以为义就不再回答他。
32.en: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

32.zh: 那时有布西人兰族巴拉迦的儿子以利户向约伯发怒；因约伯自以为义，不以神为义。
32.en: But Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, became very angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God.

32.zh: 他又向约伯的三个朋友发怒；因为他们想不出回答的话来，仍以约伯为有罪。
32.en: He was also angry with the three friends, because they had found no way to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.

32.zh: 以利户要与约伯说话，就等候他们，因为他们比自己年老。
32.en: Now Elihu had waited before speaking to Job because they were older than he.

32.zh: 以利户见这三个人口中无话回答，就怒气发作。
32.en: But when he saw that the three men had nothing more to say, his anger was aroused.

32.zh: 布西人巴拉迦的儿子以利户回答说：我年轻，你们老迈；因此我退让，不敢向你们陈说我的意见。
32.en: So Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite said: "I am young in years, and you are old; that is why I was fearful, not daring to tell you what I know.

32.zh: 我说，年老的当先说话；寿高的当以智慧 . 教训人。
32.en: I thought, 'Age should speak; advanced years should teach wisdom.'

32.zh: 但在人里面有灵；全能者的气使人有聪明。
32.en: But it is the spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives him understanding.

32.zh: 尊贵的不都有智慧；寿高的不都能明白公平。
32.en: It is not only the old who are wise, not only the aged who understand what is right.

32.zh: 因此我说：你们要听我言；我也要陈说我的意见。
32.en: "Therefore I say: Listen to me; I too will tell you what I know.

32.zh: 你们查究所要说的话；那时我等候你们的话，侧耳听你们的辩论，
32.en: I waited while you spoke, I listened to your reasoning; while you were searching for words,

32.zh: 留心听你们；谁知你们中间无一人折服约伯，驳倒他的话。
32.en: I gave you my full attention. But not one of you has proved Job wrong; none of you has answered his arguments.

32.zh: 你们切不可说：我们寻得智慧；神能胜他，人却不能。
32.en: Do not say, 'We have found wisdom; let God refute him, not man.'

32.zh: 约伯没有向我争辩；我也不用你们的话回答他。
32.en: But Job has not marshaled his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.

32.zh: 他们惊奇不再回答，一言不发。
32.en: "They are dismayed and have no more to say; words have failed them.

32.zh: 我岂因他们不说话，站住不再回答，仍旧等候呢？
32.en: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand there with no reply?

32.zh: 我也要回答我的一分话，陈说我的意见。
32.en: I too will have my say; I too will tell what I know.

32.zh: 因为我的言语满怀；我里面的灵激动我。
32.en: For I am full of words, and the spirit within me compels me;

32.zh: 我的胸怀如盛酒之囊没有出气之缝，又如新皮袋快要破裂。
32.en: inside I am like bottled-up wine, like new wineskins ready to burst.

32.zh: 我要说话，使我舒畅；我要开口回答。
32.en: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and reply.

32.zh: 我必不看人的情面，也不奉承人。
32.en: I will show partiality to no one, nor will I flatter any man;

32.zh: 我不晓得奉承；若奉承，造我的主必快快除灭我。
32.en: for if I were skilled in flattery, my Maker would soon take me away.

33.zh: 约伯啊，请听我的话，留心听我一切的言语。
33.en: "But now, Job, listen to my words;pay attention to everything I say.

33.zh: 我现在开口，用舌发言。
33.en: I am about to open my mouth; my words are on the tip of my tongue.

33.zh: 我的言语要发明心中所存的正直；我所知道的，我嘴唇要诚实地说出。
33.en: My words come from an upright heart; my lips sincerely speak what I know.

33.zh: 神的灵造我；全能者的气使我得生。
33.en: The Spirit of God has made me; the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

33.zh: 你若回答我，就站起来，在我面前陈明。
33.en: Answer me then, if you can; prepare yourself and confront me.

33.zh: 我在神面前与你一样，也是用土造成。
33.en: I am just like you before God; I too have been taken from clay.

33.zh: 我不用威严惊吓你，也不用势力重压你。
33.en: No fear of me should alarm you, nor should my hand be heavy upon you.

33.zh: 你所说的，我听见了，也听见你的言语，说：
33.en: "But you have said in my hearing- I heard the very words-

33.zh: 我是清洁无过的，我是无辜的；在我里面也没有罪孽。
33.en: 'I am pure and without sin; I am clean and free from guilt.

33.zh: 神找机会攻击我，以我为仇敌，
33.en: Yet God has found fault with me; he considers me his enemy.

33.zh: 把我的脚上了木狗，窥察我一切的道路。
33.en: He fastens my feet in shackles; he keeps close watch on all my paths.'

33.zh: 我要回答你说：你这话无理，因神比世人更大。
33.en: "But I tell you, in this you are not right, for God is greater than man.

33.zh: 你为何与他争论呢？因他的事都不对人解说？
33.en: Why do you complain to him that he answers none of man's words ?

33.zh: 神说一次 、 两次，世人却不理会。
33.en: For God does speak-now one way, now another- though man may not perceive it.

33.zh: 人躺在床上沉睡的时候，神就用梦和夜间的异象，
33.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men as they slumber in their beds,

33.zh: 开通他们的耳朵，将当受的教训印在他们心上，
33.en: he may speak in their ears and terrify them with warnings,

33.zh: 好叫人不从自己的谋算，不行骄傲的事（原文是将骄傲向人隐藏），
33.en: to turn man from wrongdoing and keep him from pride,

33.zh: 拦阻人不陷于坑里，不死在刀下。
33.en: to preserve his soul from the pit, his life from perishing by the sword.

33.zh: 人在床上被惩治，骨头中不住地疼痛，
33.en: Or a man may be chastened on a bed of pain with constant distress in his bones,

33.zh: 以致他的口厌弃食物，心厌恶美味。
33.en: so that his very being finds food repulsive and his soul loathes the choicest meal.

33.zh: 他的肉消瘦，不得再见；先前不见的骨头都凸出来。
33.en: His flesh wastes away to nothing, and his bones, once hidden, now stick out.

33.zh: 他的灵魂临近深坑；他的生命近于灭命的。
33.en: His soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the messengers of death.

33.zh: 一千天使中，若有一个作传话的与神同在，指示人所当行的事，
33.en: "Yet if there is an angel on his side as a mediator, one out of a thousand, to tell a man what is right for him,

33.zh: 神就给他开恩，说：救赎他免得下坑；我已经得了赎价。
33.en: to be gracious to him and say, 'Spare him from going down to the pit ; I have found a ransom for him'-

33.zh: 他的肉要比孩童的肉更嫩；他就返老还童。
33.en: then his flesh is renewed like a child's; it is restored as in the days of his youth.

33.zh: 他祷告神，神就喜悦他，使他欢呼朝见神的面；神又看他为义。
33.en: He prays to God and finds favor with him, he sees God's face and shouts for joy; he is restored by God to his righteous state.

33.zh: 他在人前歌唱说：我犯了罪，颠倒是非，这竟与我无益。
33.en: Then he comes to men and says, 'I sinned, and perverted what was right, but I did not get what I deserved.

33.zh: 神救赎我的灵魂免入深坑；我的生命也必见光。
33.en: He redeemed my soul from going down to the pit, and I will live to enjoy the light.'

33.zh: 神两次 、 三次向人行这一切的事，
33.en: "God does all these things to a man-twice, even three times-

33.zh: 为要从深坑救回人的灵魂，使他被光照耀，与活人一样。
33.en: to turn back his soul from the pit, that the light of life may shine on him.

33.zh: 约伯啊，你当侧耳听我的话，不要作声，等我讲说。
33.en: "Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.

33.zh: 你若有话说，就可以回答我；你只管说，因我愿以你为是。
33.en: If you have anything to say, answer me; speak up, for I want you to be cleared.

33.zh: 若不然，你就听我说；你不要作声，我便将智慧教训你。
33.en: But if not, then listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom."

34.zh: 以利户又说：
34.en: Then Elihu said:

34.zh: 你们智慧人要听我的话；有知识的人要留心听我说。
34.en: "Hear my words, you wise men; listen to me, you men of learning.

34.zh: 因为耳朵试验话语，好像上膛尝食物。
34.en: For the ear tests words as the tongue tastes food.

34.zh: 我们当选择何为是，彼此知道何为善。
34.en: Let us discern for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.

34.zh: 约伯曾说：我是公义，神夺去我的理；
34.en: "Job says, 'I am innocent, but God denies me justice.

34.zh: 我虽有理，还算为说谎言的；我虽无过，受的伤还不能医治。
34.en: Although I am right, I am considered a liar; although I am guiltless, his arrow inflicts an incurable wound.'

34.zh: 谁像约伯，喝讥诮如同喝水呢？
34.en: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water?

34.zh: 他与作孽的结伴，和恶人同行。
34.en: He keeps company with evildoers; he associates with wicked men.

34.zh: 他说：人以神为乐，总是无益。
34.en: For he says, 'It profits a man nothing when he tries to please God.'

34.zh: 所以，你们明理的人要听我的话。神断不致行恶；全能者断不致作孽。
34.en: "So listen to me, you men of understanding. Far be it from God to do evil, from the Almighty to do wrong.

34.zh: 他必按人所做的报应人，使各人照所行的得报。
34.en: He repays a man for what he has done; he brings upon him what his conduct deserves.

34.zh: 神必不作恶；全能者也不偏离公平。
34.en: It is unthinkable that God would do wrong, that the Almighty would pervert justice.

34.zh: 谁派他治理地，安定全世界呢？
34.en: Who appointed him over the earth? Who put him in charge of the whole world?

34.zh: 他若专心为己，将灵和气收归自己，
34.en: If it were his intention and he withdrew his spirit and breath,

34.zh: 凡有血气的就必一同死亡；世人必仍归尘土。
34.en: all mankind would perish together and man would return to the dust.

34.zh: 你若明理，就当听我的话，留心听我言语的声音。
34.en: "If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.

34.zh: 难道恨恶公平的可以掌权么？那有公义的 、 有大能的，岂可定他有罪么？
34.en: Can he who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One?

34.zh: 他对君王说：你是鄙陋的；对贵臣说：你是邪恶的。
34.en: Is he not the One who says to kings, 'You are worthless,' and to nobles, 'You are wicked,'

34.zh: 他待王子不徇情面，也不看重富足的过于贫穷的，因为都是他手所造。
34.en: who shows no partiality to princes and does not favor the rich over the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?

34.zh: 在转眼之间，半夜之中，他们就死亡。百姓被震动而去世；有权力的被夺去非借人手。
34.en: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night; the people are shaken and they pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.

34.zh: 神注目观看人的道路，看明人的脚步。
34.en: "His eyes are on the ways of men; he sees their every step.

34.zh: 没有黑暗 、 阴翳能给作孽的藏身。
34.en: There is no dark place, no deep shadow, where evildoers can hide.

34.zh: 神审判人，不必使人到他面前再三鉴察。
34.en: God has no need to examine men further, that they should come before him for judgment.

34.zh: 他用难测之法打破有能力的人，设立别人代替他们。
34.en: Without inquiry he shatters the mighty and sets up others in their place.

34.zh: 他原知道他们的行为，使他们在夜间倾倒灭亡。
34.en: Because he takes note of their deeds, he overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.

34.zh: 他在众人眼前击打他们，如同击打恶人一样。
34.en: He punishes them for their wickedness where everyone can see them,

34.zh: 因为他们偏行不跟从他，也不留心他的道，
34.en: because they turned from following him and had no regard for any of his ways.

34.zh: 甚至使贫穷人的哀声达到他那里；他也听了困苦人的哀声。
34.en: They caused the cry of the poor to come before him, so that he heard the cry of the needy.

34.zh: 他使人安静，谁能扰乱（或译：定罪）呢？他掩面，谁能见他呢？无论待一国或一人都是如此 ─
34.en: But if he remains silent, who can condemn him? If he hides his face, who can see him? Yet he is over man and nation alike,

34.zh: 使不虔敬的人不得作王，免得有人牢笼百姓。
34.en: to keep a godless man from ruling, from laying snares for the people.

34.zh: 有谁对神说：我受了责罚，不再犯罪；
34.en: "Suppose a man says to God, 'I am guilty but will offend no more.

34.zh: 我所看不明的，求你指教我；我若作了孽，必不再作？
34.en: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do so again.'

34.zh: 他施行报应，岂要随你的心愿 、 叫你推辞不受么？选定的是你，不是我。你所知道的只管说罢！
34.en: Should God then reward you on your terms, when you refuse to repent? You must decide, not I; so tell me what you know.

34.zh: 明理的人和听我话的智慧人必对我说：
34.en: "Men of understanding declare, wise men who hear me say to me,

34.zh: 约伯说话没有知识，言语中毫无智慧。
34.en: 'Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.'

34.zh: 愿约伯被试验到底，因他回答像恶人一样。
34.en: Oh, that Job might be tested to the utmost for answering like a wicked man!

34.zh: 他在罪上又加悖逆；在我们中间拍手，用许多言语轻慢神。
34.en: To his sin he adds rebellion; scornfully he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God."

35.zh: 你以为有理，或以为你的公义胜于神的公义，
35.en: "Do you think this is just? You say, 'I will be cleared by God. '

35.zh: 才说这与我有甚么益处？我不犯罪比犯罪有甚么好处呢？
35.en: Yet you ask him, 'What profit is it to me, and what do I gain by not sinning?'

35.zh: 我要回答你和在你这里的朋友。
35.en: "I would like to reply to you and to your friends with you.

35.zh: 你要向天观看，瞻望那高于你的穹苍。
35.en: Look up at the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds so high above you.

35.zh: 你若犯罪，能使神受何害呢？你的过犯加增，能使神受何损呢？
35.en: If you sin, how does that affect him? If your sins are many, what does that do to him?

35.zh: 你若是公义，还能加增他甚么呢？他从你手里还接受甚么呢？
35.en: If you are righteous, what do you give to him, or what does he receive from your hand?

35.zh: 你的过恶或能害你这类的人；你的公义或能叫世人得益处。
35.en: Your wickedness affects only a man like yourself, and your righteousness only the sons of men.

35.zh: 人因多受欺压就哀求，因受能者的辖制（原文是膀臂）便求救，
35.en: "Men cry out under a load of oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the powerful.

35.zh: 却无人说：造我的神在哪里？他使人夜间歌唱，
35.en: But no one says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

35.zh: 教训我们胜于地上的走兽，使我们有聪明胜于空中的飞鸟。
35.en: who teaches more to us than to the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the air?'

35.zh: 他们在那里，因恶人的骄傲呼求，却无人答应。
35.en: He does not answer when men cry out because of the arrogance of the wicked.

35.zh: 虚妄的呼求，神必不垂听；全能者也必不眷顾。
35.en: Indeed, God does not listen to their empty plea; the Almighty pays no attention to it.

35.zh: 何况你说，你不得见他；你的案件在他面前，你等候他罢。
35.en: How much less, then, will he listen when you say that you do not see him, that your case is before him and you must wait for him,

35.zh: 但如今因他未曾发怒降罚，也不甚理会狂傲，
35.en: and further, that his anger never punishes and he does not take the least notice of wickedness.

35.zh: 所以约伯开口说虚妄的话，多发无知识的言语。
35.en: So Job opens his mouth with empty talk; without knowledge he multiplies words."

36.zh: 以利户又接著说：
36.en: Elihu continued:

36.zh: 你再容我片时，我就指示你，因我还有话为神说。
36.en: "Bear with me a little longer and I will show you that there is more to be said in God's behalf.

36.zh: 我要将所知道的从远处引来，将公义归给造我的主。
36.en: I get my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe justice to my Maker.

36.zh: 我的言语真不虚谎；有知识全备的与你同在。
36.en: Be assured that my words are not false; one perfect in knowledge is with you.

36.zh: 神有大能，并不藐视人；他的智慧甚广。
36.en: "God is mighty, but does not despise men; he is mighty, and firm in his purpose.

36.zh: 他不保护恶人的性命，却为困苦人伸冤。
36.en: He does not keep the wicked alive but gives the afflicted their rights.

36.zh: 他时常看顾义人，使他们和君王同坐宝座，永远要被高举。
36.en: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; he enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.

36.zh: 他们若被锁炼捆住，被苦难的绳索缠住，
36.en: But if men are bound in chains, held fast by cords of affliction,

36.zh: 他就把他们的作为和过犯指示他们，叫他们知道有骄傲的行动。
36.en: he tells them what they have done- that they have sinned arrogantly.

36.zh: 他也开通他们的耳朵得受教训，吩咐他们离开罪孽转回。
36.en: He makes them listen to correction and commands them to repent of their evil.

36.zh: 他们若听从事奉他，就必度日亨通，历年福乐；
36.en: If they obey and serve him, they will spend the rest of their days in prosperity and their years in contentment.

36.zh: 若不听从，就要被刀杀灭，无知无识而死。
36.en: But if they do not listen, they will perish by the sword and die without knowledge.

36.zh: 那心中不敬虔的人积蓄怒气；神捆绑他们，他们竟不求救；
36.en: "The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when he fetters them, they do not cry for help.

36.zh: 必在青年时死亡，与污秽人一样丧命。
36.en: They die in their youth, among male prostitutes of the shrines.

36.zh: 神藉著困苦救拔困苦人，趁他们受欺压开通他们的耳朵。
36.en: But those who suffer he delivers in their suffering; he speaks to them in their affliction.

36.zh: 神也必引你出离患难，进入宽阔不狭窄之地；摆在你席上的必满有肥甘。
36.en: "He is wooing you from the jaws of distress to a spacious place free from restriction, to the comfort of your table laden with choice food.

36.zh: 但你满口有恶人批评的言语；判断和刑罚抓住你。
36.en: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have taken hold of you.

36.zh: 不可容忿怒触动你，使你不服责罚；也不可因赎价大就偏行。
36.en: Be careful that no one entices you by riches; do not let a large bribe turn you aside.

36.zh: 你的呼求（或译：资财），或是你一切的势力，果有灵验，叫你不受患难么？
36.en: Would your wealth or even all your mighty efforts sustain you so you would not be in distress?

36.zh: 不要切慕黑夜，就是众民在本处被除灭的时候。
36.en: Do not long for the night, to drag people away from their homes.

36.zh: 你要谨慎，不可重看罪孽，因你选择罪孽过于选择苦难。
36.en: Beware of turning to evil, which you seem to prefer to affliction.

36.zh: 神行事有高大的能力；教训人的有谁像他呢？
36.en: "God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

36.zh: 谁派定他的道路？谁能说：你所行的不义？
36.en: Who has prescribed his ways for him, or said to him, 'You have done wrong'?

36.zh: 你不可忘记称赞他所行的为大，就是人所歌颂的。
36.en: Remember to extol his work, which men have praised in song.

36.zh: 他所行的，万人都看见；世人也从远处观看。
36.en: All mankind has seen it; men gaze on it from afar.

36.zh: 神为大，我们不能全知；他的年数不能测度。
36.en: How great is God-beyond our understanding! The number of his years is past finding out.

36.zh: 他吸取水点，这水点从云雾中就变成雨；
36.en: "He draws up the drops of water, which distill as rain to the streams ;

36.zh: 云彩将雨落下，沛然降与世人。
36.en: the clouds pour down their moisture and abundant showers fall on mankind.

36.zh: 谁能明白云彩如何铺张，和神行宫的雷声呢？
36.en: Who can understand how he spreads out the clouds, how he thunders from his pavilion?

36.zh: 他将亮光普照在自己的四围；他又遮覆海底。
36.en: See how he scatters his lightning about him, bathing the depths of the sea.

36.zh: 他用这些审判众民，且赐丰富的粮食。
36.en: This is the way he governs the nations and provides food in abundance.

36.zh: 他以电光遮手，命闪电击中敌人（或译：中了靶子）。
36.en: He fills his hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.

36.zh: 所发的雷声显明他的作为，又向牲畜指明要起暴风。
36.en: His thunder announces the coming storm; even the cattle make known its approach.

37.zh: 因此我心战兢，从原处移动。
37.en: "At this my heart pounds andleaps from its place.

37.zh: 听啊，神轰轰的声音是他口中所发的响声。
37.en: Listen! Listen to the roar of his voice, to the rumbling that comes from his mouth.

37.zh: 他发响声震遍天下，发电光闪到地极。
37.en: He unleashes his lightning beneath the whole heaven and sends it to the ends of the earth.

37.zh: 随后人听见有雷声轰轰，大发威严，雷电接连不断。
37.en: After that comes the sound of his roar; he thunders with his majestic voice. When his voice resounds, he holds nothing back.

37.zh: 神发出奇妙的雷声；他行大事，我们不能测透。
37.en: God's voice thunders in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding.

37.zh: 他对雪说：要降在地上；对大雨和暴雨也是这样说。
37.en: He says to the snow, 'Fall on the earth,' and to the rain shower, 'Be a mighty downpour.'

37.zh: 他封住各人的手，叫所造的万人都晓得他的作为。
37.en: So that all men he has made may know his work, he stops every man from his labor.

37.zh: 百兽进入穴中，卧在洞内。
37.en: The animals take cover; they remain in their dens.

37.zh: 暴风出于南宫；寒冷出于北方。
37.en: The tempest comes out from its chamber, the cold from the driving winds.

37.zh: 神嘘气成冰；宽阔之水也都凝结。
37.en: The breath of God produces ice, and the broad waters become frozen.

37.zh: 他使密云盛满水气，布散电光之云；
37.en: He loads the clouds with moisture; he scatters his lightning through them.

37.zh: 这云是藉他的指引游行旋转，得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，
37.en: At his direction they swirl around over the face of the whole earth to do whatever he commands them.

37.zh: 或为责罚，或为润地，或为施行慈爱。
37.en: He brings the clouds to punish men, or to water his earth and show his love.

37.zh: 约伯啊，你要留心听，要站立思想神奇妙的作为。
37.en: "Listen to this, Job; stop and consider God's wonders.

37.zh: 神如何吩咐这些，如何使云中的电光照耀，你知道么？
37.en: Do you know how God controls the clouds and makes his lightning flash?

37.zh: 云彩如何浮于空中，那知识全备者奇妙的作为，你知道么？
37.en: Do you know how the clouds hang poised, those wonders of him who is perfect in knowledge?

37.zh: 南风使地寂静，你的衣服就如火热，你知道么？
37.en: You who swelter in your clothes when the land lies hushed under the south wind,

37.zh: 你岂能与神同铺穹苍么？这穹苍坚硬，如同铸成的镜子。
37.en: can you join him in spreading out the skies, hard as a mirror of cast bronze?

37.zh: 我们愚昧不能陈说；请你指教我们该对他说甚么话。
37.en: "Tell us what we should say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.

37.zh: 人岂可说：我愿与他说话？岂有人自愿灭亡么？
37.en: Should he be told that I want to speak? Would any man ask to be swallowed up?

37.zh: 现在有云遮蔽，人不得见穹苍的光亮；但风吹过，天又发晴。
37.en: Now no one can look at the sun, bright as it is in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.

37.zh: 金光出于北方，在神那里有可怕的威严。
37.en: Out of the north he comes in golden splendor; God comes in awesome majesty.

37.zh: 论到全能者，我们不能测度；他大有能力，有公平和大义，必不苦待人。
37.en: The Almighty is beyond our reach and exalted in power; in his justice and great righteousness, he does not oppress.

37.zh: 所以，人敬畏他；凡自以为心中有智慧的人，他都不顾念。
37.en: Therefore, men revere him, for does he not have regard for all the wise in heart? "

38.zh: 那时，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
38.en: Then the Lord answered Job outof the storm. He said:

38.zh: 谁用无知的言语使我的旨意暗昧不明，
38.en: "Who is this that darkens my counsel with words without knowledge?

38.zh: 你要如勇士束腰；我问你，你可以指示我。
38.en: Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

38.zh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说罢！
38.en: "Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.

38.zh: 你若晓得就说，是谁定地的尺度？是谁把准绳拉在其上？
38.en: Who marked off its dimensions? Surely you know! Who stretched a measuring line across it?

38.zh: 地的根基安置在何处？地的角石是谁安放的？
38.en: On what were its footings set, or who laid its cornerstone-

38.zh: 那时，晨星一同歌唱；神的众子也都欢呼。
38.en: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?

38.zh: 海水冲出，如出胎胞，那时谁将他关闭呢？
38.en: "Who shut up the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,

38.zh: 是我用云彩当海的衣服，用幽暗当包裹他的布，
38.en: when I made the clouds its garment and wrapped it in thick darkness,

38.zh: 为他定界限，又安门和闩，
38.en: when I fixed limits for it and set its doors and bars in place,

38.zh: 说：你只可到这里，不可越过；你狂傲的浪要到此止住。
38.en: when I said, 'This far you may come and no farther; here is where your proud waves halt'?

38.zh: 你自生以来，曾命定晨光，使清晨的日光知道本位，
38.en: "Have you ever given orders to the morning, or shown the dawn its place,

38.zh: 叫这光普照地的四极，将恶人从其中驱逐出来么？
38.en: that it might take the earth by the edges and shake the wicked out of it?

38.zh: 因这光，地面改变如泥上印印，万物出现如衣服一样。
38.en: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its features stand out like those of a garment.

38.zh: 亮光不照恶人；强横的膀臂也必折断。
38.en: The wicked are denied their light, and their upraised arm is broken.

38.zh: 你曾进到海源，或在深渊的隐密处行走么？
38.en: "Have you journeyed to the springs of the sea or walked in the recesses of the deep?

38.zh: 死亡的门曾向你显露么？死荫的门你曾见过么？
38.en: Have the gates of death been shown to you? Have you seen the gates of the shadow of death ?

38.zh: 地的广大你能明透么？你若全知道，只管说罢！
38.en: Have you comprehended the vast expanses of the earth? Tell me, if you know all this.

38.zh: 光明的居所从何而至？黑暗的本位在于何处？
38.en: "What is the way to the abode of light? And where does darkness reside?

38.zh: 你能带到本境，能看明其室之路么？
38.en: Can you take them to their places? Do you know the paths to their dwellings?

38.zh: 你总知道，因为你早已生在世上，你日子的数目也多。
38.en: Surely you know, for you were already born! You have lived so many years!

38.zh: 你曾进入雪库，或见过雹仓么？
38.en: "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of the hail,

38.zh: 这雪雹乃是我为降灾，并打仗和争战的日子所预备的。
38.en: which I reserve for times of trouble, for days of war and battle?

38.zh: 光亮从何路分开？东风从何路分散遍地？
38.en: What is the way to the place where the lightning is dispersed, or the place where the east winds are scattered over the earth?

38.zh: 谁为雨水分道？谁为雷电开路？
38.en: Who cuts a channel for the torrents of rain, and a path for the thunderstorm,

38.zh: 使雨降在无人之地 、 无人居住的旷野？
38.en: to water a land where no man lives, a desert with no one in it,

38.zh: 使荒废凄凉之地得以丰足，青草得以发生？
38.en: to satisfy a desolate wasteland and make it sprout with grass?

38.zh: 雨有父么？露水珠是谁生的呢？
38.en: Does the rain have a father? Who fathers the drops of dew?

38.zh: 冰出于谁的胎？天上的霜是谁生的呢？
38.en: From whose womb comes the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens

38.zh: 诸水坚硬（或译：隐藏）如石头；深渊之面凝结成冰。
38.en: when the waters become hard as stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen?

38.zh: 你能系住昴星的结么？能解开参星的带么？
38.en: "Can you bind the beautiful Pleiades? Can you loose the cords of Orion?

38.zh: 你能按时领出十二宫么？能引导北斗和随他的众星（星：原文是子）么？
38.en: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear with its cubs?

38.zh: 你知道天的定例么？能使地归在天的权下么？
38.en: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set up God's dominion over the earth?

38.zh: 你能向云彩扬起声来，使倾盆的雨遮盖你么？
38.en: "Can you raise your voice to the clouds and cover yourself with a flood of water?

38.zh: 你能发出闪电，叫他行去，使他对你说：我们在这里？
38.en: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, 'Here we are'?

38.zh: 谁将智慧放在怀中？谁将聪明赐于心内？
38.en: Who endowed the heart with wisdom or gave understanding to the mind ?

38.zh: 谁能用智慧数算云彩呢？尘土聚集成团，土块紧紧结连；那时，谁能倾倒天上的瓶呢？
38.en: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Who can tip over the water jars of the heavens

38.zh: a
38.en: when the dust becomes hard and the clods of earth stick together?

38.zh: 母狮子在洞中蹲伏，少壮狮子在隐密处埋伏；你能为他们抓取食物，使他们饱足么？
38.en: "Do you hunt the prey for the lioness and satisfy the hunger of the lions

38.zh: a
38.en: when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in a thicket?

38.zh: 乌鸦之雏因无食物飞来飞去，哀告神；那时，谁为他预备食物呢？
38.en: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God and wander about for lack of food?

39.zh: 山岩间的野山羊几时生产，你知道么？母鹿下犊之期，你能察定么？
39.en: "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears her fawn?

39.zh: 他们怀胎的月数，你能数算么？他们几时生产，你能晓得么？
39.en: Do you count the months till they bear? Do you know the time they give birth?

39.zh: 他们屈身，将子生下，就除掉疼痛。
39.en: They crouch down and bring forth their young; their labor pains are ended.

39.zh: 这子渐渐肥壮，在荒野长大，去而不回。
39.en: Their young thrive and grow strong in the wilds; they leave and do not return.

39.zh: 谁放野驴出去自由？谁解开快驴的绳索？
39.en: "Who let the wild donkey go free? Who untied his ropes?

39.zh: 我使旷野作他的住处，使咸地当他的居所。
39.en: I gave him the wasteland as his home, the salt flats as his habitat.

39.zh: 他嗤笑城内的喧嚷，不听赶牲口的喝声。
39.en: He laughs at the commotion in the town; he does not hear a driver's shout.

39.zh: 遍山是他的草场；他寻找各样青绿之物。
39.en: He ranges the hills for his pasture and searches for any green thing.

39.zh: 野牛岂肯服事你？岂肯住在你的槽旁？
39.en: "Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will he stay by your manger at night?

39.zh: 你岂能用套绳将野牛笼在犁沟之间？他岂肯随你耙山谷之地？
39.en: Can you hold him to the furrow with a harness? Will he till the valleys behind you?

39.zh: 岂可因他的力大就倚靠他？岂可把你的工交给他做么？
39.en: Will you rely on him for his great strength? Will you leave your heavy work to him?

39.zh: 岂可信靠他把你的粮食运到家，又收聚你禾场上的谷么？
39.en: Can you trust him to bring in your grain and gather it to your threshing floor?

39.zh: 鸵鸟的翅膀欢然搧展，岂是显慈爱的翎毛和羽毛么？
39.en: "The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but they cannot compare with the pinions and feathers of the stork.

39.zh: 因他把蛋留在地上，在尘土中使得温暖；
39.en: She lays her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand,

39.zh: 却想不到被脚踹碎，或被野兽践踏。
39.en: unmindful that a foot may crush them, that some wild animal may trample them.

39.zh: 他忍心待雏，似乎不是自己的；虽然徒受劳苦，也不为雏惧怕；
39.en: She treats her young harshly, as if they were not hers; she cares not that her labor was in vain,

39.zh: 因为神使他没有智慧，也未将悟性赐给他。
39.en: for God did not endow her with wisdom or give her a share of good sense.

39.zh: 他几时挺身展开翅膀，就嗤笑马和骑马的人。
39.en: Yet when she spreads her feathers to run, she laughs at horse and rider.

39.zh: 马的大力是你所赐的么？他颈项上挓挲的鬃是你给他披上的么？
39.en: "Do you give the horse his strength or clothe his neck with a flowing mane?

39.zh: 是你叫他跳跃像蝗虫么？他喷气之威使人惊惶。
39.en: Do you make him leap like a locust, striking terror with his proud snorting?

39.zh: 他在谷中刨地，自喜其力；他出去迎接佩带兵器的人。
39.en: He paws fiercely, rejoicing in his strength, and charges into the fray.

39.zh: 他嗤笑可怕的事并不惊惶，也不因刀剑退回。
39.en: He laughs at fear, afraid of nothing; he does not shy away from the sword.

39.zh: 箭袋和发亮的枪，并短枪在他身上铮铮有声。
39.en: The quiver rattles against his side, along with the flashing spear and lance.

39.zh: 他发猛烈的怒气将地吞下；一听角声就不耐站立。
39.en: In frenzied excitement he eats up the ground; he cannot stand still when the trumpet sounds.

39.zh: 角每发声，他说呵哈；他从远处闻著战气，又听见军长大发雷声和兵丁呐喊。
39.en: At the blast of the trumpet he snorts, 'Aha!' He catches the scent of battle from afar, the shout of commanders and the battle cry.

39.zh: 鹰雀飞翔，展开翅膀一直向南，岂是藉你的智慧么？
39.en: "Does the hawk take flight by your wisdom and spread his wings toward the south?

39.zh: 大鹰上腾在高处搭窝，岂是听你的吩咐么？
39.en: Does the eagle soar at your command and build his nest on high?

39.zh: 他住在山岩，以山峰和坚固之所为家，
39.en: He dwells on a cliff and stays there at night; a rocky crag is his stronghold.

39.zh: 从那里窥看食物，眼睛远远观望。
39.en: From there he seeks out his food; his eyes detect it from afar.

39.zh: 他的雏也咂血；被杀的人在哪里，他也在那里。
39.en: His young ones feast on blood, and where the slain are, there is he."

40.zh: 耶和华又对约伯说：
40.en: The Lord said to Job:

40.zh: 强辩的岂可与全能者争论么？与神辩驳的可以回答这些罢！
40.en: "Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him? Let him who accuses God answer him!"

40.zh: 于是，约伯回答耶和华说：
40.en: Then Job answered the Lord :

40.zh: 我是卑贱的！我用甚么回答你呢？只好用手摀口。
40.en: "I am unworthy-how can I reply to you? I put my hand over my mouth.

40.zh: 我说了一次，再不回答；说了两次，就不再说。
40.en: I spoke once, but I have no answer-twice, but I will say no more."

40.zh: 于是，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
40.en: Then the Lord spoke to Job out of the storm:

40.zh: 你要如勇士束腰；我问你，你可以指示我。
40.en: "Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

40.zh: 你岂可废弃我所拟定的？岂可定我有罪，好显自己为义么？
40.en: "Would you discredit my justice? Would you condemn me to justify yourself?

40.zh: 你有神那样的膀臂么？你能像他发雷声么？
40.en: Do you have an arm like God's, and can your voice thunder like his?

40.zh: 你要以荣耀庄严为妆饰，以尊荣威严为衣服；
40.en: Then adorn yourself with glory and splendor, and clothe yourself in honor and majesty.

40.zh: 要发出你满溢的怒气，见一切骄傲的人，使他降卑；
40.en: Unleash the fury of your wrath, look at every proud man and bring him low,

40.zh: 见一切骄傲的人，将他制伏，把恶人践踏在本处；
40.en: look at every proud man and humble him, crush the wicked where they stand.

40.zh: 将他们一同隐藏在尘土中，把他们的脸蒙蔽在隐密处；
40.en: Bury them all in the dust together; shroud their faces in the grave.

40.zh: 我就认你右手能以救自己。
40.en: Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

40.zh: 你且观看河马；我造你也造他。他吃草与牛一样；
40.en: "Look at the behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.

40.zh: 他的气力在腰间，能力在肚腹的筋上。
40.en: What strength he has in his loins, what power in the muscles of his belly!

40.zh: 他摇动尾巴如香柏树；他大腿的筋互相联络。
40.en: His tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are close-knit.

40.zh: 他的骨头好像铜管；他的肢体彷佛铁棍。
40.en: His bones are tubes of bronze, his limbs like rods of iron.

40.zh: 他在神所造的物中为首；创造他的给他刀剑。
40.en: He ranks first among the works of God, yet his Maker can approach him with his sword.

40.zh: 诸山给他出食物，也是百兽游玩之处。
40.en: The hills bring him their produce, and all the wild animals play nearby.

40.zh: 他伏在莲叶之下，卧在芦苇隐密处和水洼子里。
40.en: Under the lotus plants he lies, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.

40.zh: 莲叶的阴凉遮蔽他；溪旁的柳树环绕他。
40.en: The lotuses conceal him in their shadow; the poplars by the stream surround him.

40.zh: 河水泛滥，他不发战；就是约但河的水涨到他口边，也是安然。
40.en: When the river rages, he is not alarmed; he is secure, though the Jordan should surge against his mouth.

40.zh: 在他防备的时候，谁能捉拿他？谁能牢笼他穿他的鼻子呢？
40.en: Can anyone capture him by the eyes, or trap him and pierce his nose?

41.zh: 你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼么？能用绳子压下他的舌头么？
41.en: "Can you pull in the leviathan with a fishhook or tie down his tongue with a rope?

41.zh: 你能用绳索穿他的鼻子么？能用钩穿他的腮骨么？
41.en: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?

41.zh: 他岂向你连连恳求，说柔和的话么？
41.en: Will he keep begging you for mercy? Will he speak to you with gentle words?

41.zh: 岂肯与你立约，使你拿他永远作奴仆么？
41.en: Will he make an agreement with you for you to take him as your slave for life?

41.zh: 你岂可拿他当雀鸟玩耍么？岂可为你的幼女将他拴住么？
41.en: Can you make a pet of him like a bird or put him on a leash for your girls?

41.zh: 搭伙的渔夫岂可拿他当货物么？能把他分给商人么？
41.en: Will traders barter for him? Will they divide him up among the merchants?

41.zh: 你能用倒钩枪扎满他的皮，能用鱼叉叉满他的头么？
41.en: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?

41.zh: 你按手在他身上，想与他争战，就不再这样行罢！
41.en: If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the struggle and never do it again!

41.zh: 人指望捉拿他是徒然的；一见他，岂不丧胆么？
41.en: Any hope of subduing him is false; the mere sight of him is overpowering.

41.zh: 没有那么凶猛的人敢惹他。这样，谁能在我面前站立得住呢？
41.en: No one is fierce enough to rouse him. Who then is able to stand against me?

41.zh: 谁先给我甚么，使我偿还呢？天下万物都是我的。
41.en: Who has a claim against me that I must pay? Everything under heaven belongs to me.

41.zh: 论到鳄鱼的肢体和其大力，并美好的骨骼，我不能缄默不言。
41.en: "I will not fail to speak of his limbs, his strength and his graceful form.

41.zh: 谁能剥他的外衣？谁能进他上下牙骨之间呢？
41.en: Who can strip off his outer coat? Who would approach him with a bridle?

41.zh: 谁能开他的腮颊？他牙齿四围是可畏的。
41.en: Who dares open the doors of his mouth, ringed about with his fearsome teeth?

41.zh: 他以坚固的鳞甲为可夸，紧紧合闭，封得严密。
41.en: His back has rows of shields tightly sealed together;

41.zh: 这鳞甲一一相连，甚至气不得透入其间，
41.en: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.

41.zh: 都是互相联络 、 胶结，不能分离。
41.en: They are joined fast to one another; they cling together and cannot be parted.

41.zh: 他打喷嚏就发出光来；他眼睛好像早晨的光线（原文是眼皮）。
41.en: His snorting throws out flashes of light; his eyes are like the rays of dawn.

41.zh: 从他口中发出烧著的火把，与飞迸的火星；
41.en: Firebrands stream from his mouth; sparks of fire shoot out.

41.zh: 从他鼻孔冒出烟来，如烧开的锅和点著的芦苇。
41.en: Smoke pours from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

41.zh: 他的气点著煤炭，有火焰从他口中发出。
41.en: His breath sets coals ablaze, and flames dart from his mouth.

41.zh: 他颈项中存著劲力；在他面前的都恐吓蹦跳。
41.en: Strength resides in his neck; dismay goes before him.

41.zh: 他的肉块互相联络，紧贴其身，不能摇动。
41.en: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.

41.zh: 他的心结实如石头，如下磨石那样结实。
41.en: His chest is hard as rock, hard as a lower millstone.

41.zh: 他一起来，勇士都惊恐，心里慌乱，便都昏迷。
41.en: When he rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before his thrashing.

41.zh: 人若用刀，用枪，用标枪，用尖枪扎他，都是无用。
41.en: The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or the dart or the javelin.

41.zh: 他以铁为干草，以铜为烂木。
41.en: Iron he treats like straw and bronze like rotten wood.

41.zh: 箭不能恐吓他使他逃避；弹石在他看为碎秸。
41.en: Arrows do not make him flee; slingstones are like chaff to him.

41.zh: 棍棒算为禾秸；他嗤笑短枪飕的响声。
41.en: A club seems to him but a piece of straw; he laughs at the rattling of the lance.

41.zh: 他肚腹下如尖瓦片；他如钉耙经过淤泥。
41.en: His undersides are jagged potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

41.zh: 他使深渊开滚如锅，使洋海如锅中的膏油。
41.en: He makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.

41.zh: 他行的路随后发光，令人想深渊如同白发。
41.en: Behind him he leaves a glistening wake; one would think the deep had white hair.

41.zh: 在地上没有像他造的那样，无所惧怕。
41.en: Nothing on earth is his equal- a creature without fear.

41.zh: 凡高大的，他无不藐视；他在骄傲的水族上作王。
41.en: He looks down on all that are haughty; he is king over all that are proud."

42.en: Then Job replied to the Lord :

42.zh: 我知道，你万事都能做；你的旨意不能拦阻。
42.en: "I know that you can do all things; no plan of yours can be thwarted.

42.zh: 谁用无知的言语使你的旨意隐藏呢？我所说的是我不明白的；这些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。
42.en: You asked, 'Who is this that obscures my counsel without knowledge?' Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.

42.zh: 求你听我，我要说话；我问你，求你指示我。
42.en: "You said, 'Listen now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you shall answer me.'

42.zh: 我从前风闻有你，现在亲眼看见你。
42.en: My ears had heard of you but now my eyes have seen you.

42.zh: 因此我厌恶自己（或译：我的言语），在尘土和炉灰中懊悔。
42.en: Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes."

42.zh: 耶和华对约伯说话以后，就对提幔人以利法说：我的怒气向你和你两个朋友发作，因为你们议论我不如我的仆人约伯说的是。
42.en: After the Lord had said these things to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "I am angry with you and your two friends, because you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has.

42.zh: 现在你们要取七只公牛，七只公羊，到我仆人约伯那里去，为自己献上燔祭，我的仆人约伯就为你们祈祷。我因悦纳他，就不按你们的愚妄办你们。你们议论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的是。
42.en: So now take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. You have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has."

42.zh: 于是提幔人以利法 、 书亚人比勒达 、 拿玛人琐法照著耶和华所吩咐的去行；耶和华就悦纳约伯。
42.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the Lord told them; and the Lord accepted Job's prayer.

42.zh: 约伯为他的朋友祈祷。耶和华就使约伯从苦境（原文是掳掠）转回，并且耶和华赐给他的比他从前所有的加倍。
42.en: After Job had prayed for his friends, the Lord made him prosperous again and gave him twice as much as he had before.

42.zh: 约伯的弟兄 、 姊妹，和以先所认识的人都来见他，在他家里一同吃饭；又论到耶和华所降与他的一切灾祸，都为他悲伤安慰他。每人也送他一块银子和一个金环。
42.en: All his brothers and sisters and everyone who had known him before came and ate with him in his house. They comforted and consoled him over all the trouble the Lord had brought upon him, and each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.

42.zh: 这样，耶和华后来赐福给约伯比先前更多。他有一万四千羊，六千骆驼，一千对牛，一千母驴。
42.en: The Lord blessed the latter part of Job's life more than the first. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen and a thousand donkeys.

42.zh: 他也有七个儿子，三个女儿。
42.en: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.

42.zh: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女叫基洗亚，三女叫基连哈朴。
42.en: The first daughter he named Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-Happuch.

42.zh: 在那全地的妇女中找不著像约伯的女儿那样美貌。他们的父亲使他们在弟兄中得产业。
42.en: Nowhere in all the land were there found women as beautiful as Job's daughters, and their father granted them an inheritance along with their brothers.

42.zh: 此后，约伯又活了一百四十年，得见他的儿孙，直到四代。
42.en: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.

42.zh: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，日子满足而死。
